findings.finding: Success reconciliation can mark completed without revalidating the complete worker terminal, replay, counter, formal identity, sandbox, guard and execution-event semantics.
findings.action: Persist the execution event in the success bundle and rerun the full worker and event semantic validators before any completed recovery transition.

findings.finding: The exact success file set is enforced, but authorization, claim, 1410-input inventory, runtime constants and current production identity are not fully rebound during recovery.
findings.action: Validate the exact authorization bound-file set and current hashes, rebuild and bind the complete input and runtime contracts, and compare current production identity before completed recovery.

findings.finding: The production correlation snapshot can return zero active peers before enumerating actual same-direction positions when candidate history is unavailable.
findings.action: Expose an explicit candidate-history availability state and fail closed whenever correlation availability is unknown.
